newsitem.title: ITALY: Bulgari 1996 net profits rise 46 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgari 1996 net profits rise 46 pct.

text.p: Dividend per share 220 lire vs 180 lire

Italian luxury goods group Bulgari said in a statement that its operating profit margin over sales rose to 15.6 percent from 11.9 percent in 1995, and its net profit margin over sales increased to 12.9 percent from 10.3 percent.
The group's breakdown of sales against 1995 by category was: jewellery 42 percent (44 percent), watches 42 percent (42 percent), perfumes 14 percent (12 percent) and royalities 2 percent (2 percent).
The group's managing director Francesco Trapani said in a statement that the group was very satisfied with the strong growth and expansion of the group in 1996.
"For 1997, the positive indications of the market and sales volumes already seen in the first months of the year give us hope for a further rise in sales and net profits," he said.
Bulgari said its number of shops worldwide reached 54 by the end of 1996 and it planned to open a further 10 shops in 1997.
